name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Fresh applicants must rank above the 80th percentile among successful Class XII candidates in their board and stream.
The annual family income ceiling is ₹4.5 lakh.
Fresh applicants cannot receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement.
For fresh applications, confirm first-year admission to a regular degree after completing Class XII in the previous academic year. Diploma and gap-year applicants are excluded.

requiredDocuments.name: Category or caste certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: Fresh application in a reserved category.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The college scheme covers OBC, EBC and DNT students.
Total annual family income from all sources may be up to ₹2.5 lakh.
Check full-time admission to an eligible course at an institution notified for this cycle, along with merit and available slots.
At most two siblings in a family can receive this benefit.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The scholarship is open to Indian nationals.
A benchmark disability of at least 40% must be certified by the competent authority.
The post-matric parental income ceiling is ₹2.5 lakh annually.
Verify eligible studies from Class XI through qualifying postgraduate courses. Confirm any applicable repeat-year, sibling and other scholarship or stipend restrictions.

name: Karnataka DTE Post-Matric Fee Reimbursement for ST Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: This record covers the Scheduled Tribe reimbursement described in the circular.
Check the applicable income band cited in the circular as ₹2.5 lakh to ₹10 lakh. Confirm treatment of the boundary amounts with DTE and SSP.
Confirm an eligible Karnataka diploma, engineering, architecture or postgraduate course and the applicable admission route. Donation and management-quota seats are excluded.

requiredDocuments.name: Annual family income certificate RD number
Salary certificate, pension certificate, or income tax return certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: As applicable to the parent or guardian's income source.

name: Karnataka DTE Scholarship for Dependents of Defence Personnel

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Check the applicant's dependency and the service member's eligible Indian Army, Navy or Air Force rank under the circular and certificate notes.
Confirm an eligible polytechnic diploma, BE, BTech or BArch admission. Check the allowed seat and counselling route against the circular.

requiredDocuments.name: Defence service certificate signed by the competent authority

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree)

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Annual family income from all sources may be up to ₹8 lakh.
Confirm the applicant meets the scheme's girl-student eligibility, the limit of two girls per family, and admission to year one or lateral entry into year two of an AICTE-approved technical degree.
Check the AICTE restrictions on other scholarships and dual degree programmes.

requiredDocuments.name: Diploma certificate and marksheet
requiredDocuments.condition: Fresh degree application through lateral entry.

requiredDocuments.name: Institution study or bona fide certificate

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Technical Degree)

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Annual family income from all sources may be up to ₹8 lakh.
The applicant must have a disability of 40% or more.
Confirm admission to year one or lateral entry into year two of an AICTE-approved technical degree and check the restrictions on other scholarships.

requiredDocuments.name: Diploma certificate and marksheet
requiredDocuments.condition: Fresh degree application through lateral entry.

requiredDocuments.name: Institution study or bona fide certificate

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Annual family income from all sources may be up to ₹8 lakh under the general eligibility rule.
Check that the student is in years one through four of a regular AICTE-approved technical degree and qualifies under one of the family circumstances in section 2.
Check the restrictions on other financial assistance. Confirm the income limit with AICTE if income equals ₹8 lakh because some document instructions specify a stricter threshold.

requiredDocuments.name: Class X and Class XII or equivalent marksheets
Proof of qualifying family circumstances
requiredDocuments.condition: Use the documents for the applicable category in the AICTE guidelines.

requiredDocuments.name: Current annual family income certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: Where required for the applicant's category.

name: UGC National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The scholarship is for Indian students.
Applicants must be under 30 on admission to the first year or semester of the postgraduate programme.

Confirm first-year admission to the applicant's first recognized postgraduate degree through regular full-time study at an eligible institution. For integrated degrees, only the postgraduate component qualifies.

name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class)

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The scholarship component covers Scheduled Tribe students.
Confirm merit admission to an eligible graduate or postgraduate course at a notified institution. Private management-quota admissions are excluded.
Check the ₹6 lakh annual income ceiling using the scheme's family income definition, including its exemption for an orphan supported by a guardian.
Check for other central or state scholarships for the same course of study.

requiredDocuments.name: Applicable income certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: Fresh application where the income criterion applies.

requiredDocuments.name: Qualifying examination or latest passing-semester marksheet
requiredDocuments.condition: Use the marksheet for the applicable course and application type.
